note: Card-only scaffold. Components come from the user's design-system library (linked into the working file), NOT from this scaffold. init seeds only the conventions card so the file is legible to the pipeline.

pages.name: 📐 Conventions
pages.note: Create/reuse this page and drop the conventions card into it as a single locked text node rendered to NATIVE Figma text styling (see conventionsCard.styling). Read conventions/designer-card.md directly — the scaffold never seeds a stale rendered copy.

styling.note: Figma text nodes do NOT render Markdown. The scaffold parses the card and applies native Figma text styling per range (headings bold + stepped size, inline **bold**, clean bullets) via figma_execute — see the figma-write 'scaffold (init)' workflow for the exact, validated recipe. Markers (#, **, backticks, leading - / *) are stripped, never pasted literally.
styling.bold: headings + inline **…** ranges; uses the created node's own font family in Bold, falling back to size-only if the Bold style isn't available
styling.fallback: if figma_execute / the bridge is unavailable, create a single locked text node with the parsed PLAIN text (markers still stripped) and warn that styling was skipped — never paste raw Markdown
